rules.field: NEW fixed30ft-radius sphere centered at a perceived point within native30ft and actual LoE; concentration60elapsed seconds, automatic/no save. Extend only the exact ordinary Silence acoustic-path contract: no sound originates, propagates or is heard inside or crosses the closed sphere. Two outside points whose actual sound path crosses it cannot communicate through that path; a real alternative unobstructed route is not forbidden. Record voice-source,ear/microphone and actual path, not merely creature-center membership. No vacuum, lost breathing, thunder immunity, permanent Deafened or general antimagic.
rules.componentsAndCommands: Audible V inside an existing blocking sphere cannot begin; no payment for a known invalid V attempt. An outside caster may finish V before its own field manifests, then maintain concentration inside silently. Genuine acquired nonverbal exceptions retain exact source/cost, not universal silent casting. Audible commands/triggers/music fail only when their actual path is blocked; a documented visual/mental channel may operate with its own real budget. A missed command is not stored, reissued or refunded on exit. An independent thunder spell requiring sound perception/trigger still needs it; this field supplies neither.
rules.eligibility: NEW double only a genuine ordinary spell identity thunder-damage component at original-recipient pre-save resolution when that recipient occupied creature body or admitted object/structural-section volume has interior intersection with at least one active unsuppressed field. Caster position and sound propagation do not determine amplification. Delayed direct spell components remain eligible only when their actual source envelope makes them spell damage. Summoned creature/weapon attacks, class techniques not actual ordinary spell components, collision, mundane sound and a thunder label alone are excluded. An actual spell-created weapon attack is not admitted solely by creator spell; only an explicit accepted source classifying that damage as a direct spell component qualifies. This return grants no such classification to an unbound source.
rules.arithmetic: NEW factor2 on the complete eligible raw thunder component (rolled dice including already-resolved attack critical dice plus actual same-type flat damage modifiers), once BEFORE its recipient save-half/negation and later defenses. Preserve one shared area base pool; multiply per eligible original recipient, not by doubling the shared roll globally. Mixed nonthunder components unchanged. Multiple fields give one factor, not2^n. Choose earliest currently established qualifying field, tie stable sourceID, and record it only as amplification provider, never damage dealer.
rules.rootMark: NEW E159-AMP-01 places an immutable amplificationDecision {eligible,factor,provider,stage} on each original-recipient damage event/root at its initial pre-save evaluation. A pure transfer or retained split inherits that exact decision and processed component amounts; it never re-enters amplification or defenses even if transferred from outside into a field. Decision factor1 likewise prevents a transfer-only second admission. Actual separately paid/authorized later damaging activation has a new recipient event/root and may qualify then. Traversal,boundary re-entry,redirected descendants,suppression/resumption and ownership changes cannot multiply the same event again.
rules.lifecycle: Both acoustics and amplification pause under actual source-qualified suppression, original clock runs. Independent fields keep their deadlines; removal of one reveals others. Future events re-evaluate remaining fields, but already marked/resolved damage is never undone or reprocessed. Source end/death/concentration loss/removal/expiry stops future functions; no stored voices, delayed commands, banked multiplier or final discharge.
